notes: This dataset contains the codes used to reproduce the figures in the article “Stability of bond clusters with a characteristic length scale for load distribution” by Lüdemann et al. The directory is organized into subfolders, each containing the Jupyter notebooks used to generate the plots for Figures 3–9 of the article. Each subfolder is named according to its corresponding figure. These codes have been produced by Yannick Lüdemann. If you have any questions about the codes please contact Stefan Klumpp stefan.klumpp@phys.uni-goettingen.de.
